motivation: The frozen selected62 head has60 TRAIN binary misses,59 with correct argmax across all six fields. Test direct supervision of the coupled-policy probability while retaining binary/field supervision. This is an unproven hypothesis, and existing DEV joint-field failures also remain.
novelty_scope: Direct policy supervision already exists in v9 research. This experiment applies its unchanged policy semantics to the bound larger62 corpus using an MLX CPU implementation and a matched no-policy-loss control. It is not a novel policy definition.
data_policy: Reuse exactly the62 TRAIN/DEV feature population. No new rows, relabeling, rejected66 or draft69 records. No reservedTEST files or diagnostics enter fitting. No additional encoder inference.
initialization: Original-v9 128-hidden-unit normalized GELU head for each language, fresh seed1011 per configuration and shared deterministic minibatch order. Fixed original-v9 encoder features and pair potentials. All configurations start from the same original weights, not selected62.
loss: Existing binaryCE + mean class-weighted six-fieldCE +0.2 mean seven-head teacherKL, plus registered coefficient times BCE of the existing coupled-policy probability. Clamp probability to[1e-6,1-1e-6] only for BCE. Policy semantics, inference scorer and fixed couplings do not change.
optimizer: Same AdamW learning rate0.0001, decay0.01, gradient clip1.0; batch64,12 epochs per configuration. CPU execution differs from prior62 GPU execution, so policy-control is rerun on the same backend as the two treatments.
selection: Retain existing DEV-only rule: assess binary, policy and coupled-policy modes and their DEV-only thresholds; choose minimum binary errors then maximum score margin per checkpoint; rank checkpoints by binary errors, joint-field errors, mean field CE, then negative margin, with earliest exact tie retained. Selection spans all three configurations. Record the selected mode; do not attribute an improvement to serving-policy alignment if evidence does not support it.
verification: Before fitting, verify analytic probability against runtime scoring and full ontology-world enumeration; verify gradients against finite differences and existing PyTorch implementation with actual RO/UK couplings; verify the actual zero-policy training loss/gradient exactly matches the old loss and nonzero settings add only the registered term. Check all input/source hashes and labels. At runtime compare every initial DEV head logit to cached v9 within1e-3, save all checkpoint hashes/counters, and verify selected reload within1e-5 with unchanged argmax.
evaluation: Freeze selection before all exposed original/broad/trajectory/challenge regressions. Zero binary AND joint-field DEV errors are prerequisite for further qualification, and all other zero-error/no-regression requirements remain. A failed DEV gate is REJECT, not a release. ReservedTEST and final human-review stages stay closed until all engineering prerequisites pass.
resources: Only small readout heads and cached final features run on CPU; no encoder is loaded. May run alongside the single fullencoder65 job. Request two BLAS/OpenMP threads, process one language at a time, preserve8GiB disk reserve and retain every failed checkpoint. No paid compute, auto-restarts or result-dependent extensions.
